meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后，该技能会改动 NanoClaw 配置：给容器固定安装并启用一个文档转换工具。之后 agent 收到 Word、PPT、Excel 等附件时，可直接在本地转成 Markdown 文本，再读取或总结，文件不会发到外部服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取收到的 Word、PPT、Excel 等办公附件，同时你希望文件不交给外部解析服务时，才会用到这个转换能力。

say.text: 请把附件里的 Word 转成 Markdown，然后概括内容。
say.note: 转换在本地完成，Claude 会读取转换后的文本。

say.text: 这份 Excel 附件转成 Markdown 后，告诉我有哪些字段。
say.note: Claude 会根据转换结果回答，文件不会被上传。

say.text: 把这个 PPT 转成 Markdown，只讲其中的重点。
say.note: Claude 只归纳相关段落，不输出整篇全文。

howto.what_en: After install, this skill changes NanoClaw by pinning and enabling a document-conversion tool in agent containers. Incoming office files (Word, PPT, Excel, etc.) become Markdown locally for reading/summarizing, never uploaded.
howto.when_en: When an agent must read attached office files (Word, PPT, Excel, etc.) and you want the conversion to happen locally rather than sending them to an external parser.

say_en.text: Please convert the attached Word document to Markdown and summarize it.
say_en.note: Conversion happens locally; Claude reads the Markdown.

say_en.text: Convert the attached Excel file to Markdown and tell me its fields.
say_en.note: It answers from the converted Markdown, no file upload.

say_en.text: Turn this PPT into Markdown and only highlight key points.
say_en.note: It summarizes the relevant Markdown sections only.
